//: Story Phase 4: Garrick, Squawks and Pete between scenes.
garrick.p4_s1: garrick[smug]: Good morning, Captain. A lovely day for it.
garrick[businesslike]: That's what the forecast is for.
garrick.p4_inspect_hint: garrick[businesslike]: It's on the table, Captain. Under your breakfast. Study it. Take your time.
garrick.p4_board_hint: garrick[proud]: The Forecast Board, Captain! By my barrel, midships. People are already queueing. Well. Pete looked at it.
garrick.p4_s2_1: garrick[businesslike]: The morning's forecast was entirely correct, Captain. It predicted the Center. The Center arrived. The timing was a matter of interpretation.
garrick.p4_s2_2: garrick[proud]: Have you seen people at the board? Looking at it? That's engagement, Captain.
garrick.p4_s3_1: garrick[businesslike]: The secret of living with the Center, Captain, is routine. Up at dawn. Forecast. Breakfast. Evacuate breakfast. Second breakfast.
garrick.p4_s3_2: garrick[smug]: The bell protocol was my idea, of course. Well. Level four was my idea. Well. Level four is ABOUT me. Which is almost the same.
garrick.p4_s3b: garrick[smug]: Sleeping on deck is marvellous for the constitution. I'd join the crew, but somebody has to sleep in a proper bed and report back on what it's like.
garrick.p4_s4_1: garrick[businesslike]: It has excellent instincts, the Center. Goes where it's needed. I find that very professional.
garrick.p4_s4_2: garrick[proud]: I've been asked whether I can control it, Captain. I can't. But I've been ASKED. That's recognition.
garrick.p4_log_hint: garrick[businesslike]: It's in the log, Captain. The stand by my barrel. The page for your beard. Best handwriting.
garrick.p4_s5: garrick[happy]: Lovely technique, Captain! Very... pokey. Carry on! Don't mind me.
garrick.p4_s6: garrick[delighted]: I've never seen anything like it, Captain. I'm going to need more paper.
garrick.p4_s7: garrick[proud]: Excellent work, everyone! I'm writing you all up for a commendation. In crayon.
garrick.p4_s8: garrick[businesslike]: On the bright side, Captain, the sharks will be very full.
garrick.p4_s9_1: garrick[proud]: Seven hundred percent, Captain. I've never been so confident in a forecast in my life.
garrick.p4_s9_2: garrick[businesslike]: I'm considering a weekly edition. Forecast, Stench Log highlights, a puzzle page. We could charge.
garrick.p4_s9_3: garrick[smug]: The sash is holding up well, Captain. The office requires a certain standard. So does the sash.
squawks.p4_s1: squawks[smug]: Golden feather. Still there. Squawks checks every hour. Every HOUR.
squawks.p4_s2: squawks[insulting]: Bad here. Probably. HA. Stinky one's map is BAD.
squawks.p4_s3: squawks[smug]: THREE, Captain! One golden, two green! Squawks is growing BACK!
squawks.p4_s3b: squawks[smug]: Crew sleep on the deck. Squawks sleeps in the Captain's cabin. Squawks is the ONLY one with any sense.
squawks.p4_s4: squawks[smug]: More feathers coming! Captain count later! Squawks is busy GROWING.
squawks.p4_bald_1: squawks[exhausted]: ...Squawks doesn't want to talk about it.
squawks.p4_bald_2: squawks[insulting]: Fart hates feathers. Squawks hates fart.
squawks.p4_bald_3: squawks[neutral]: They came back once. Captain said. Squawks is a tough old bird.
squawks.p4_s5: squawks[furious]: Sharks! Bite the SHARKS, Captain! On the NOSE!
squawks.p4_s7: squawks[smug]: Squawks is supervising. Like the stinky one. But GOOD.
squawks.p4_s9_1: squawks[exhausted]: Seven hundred. Squawks can count to seven hundred now. Squawks learned from the bad map.
squawks.p4_s9_2: squawks[neutral]: Feathers come back. Squawks waits. Squawks is patient. Squawks is VERY patient.
pete.p4_s1: pete[tired]: Morning, Captain. Pete. Night watch. Well, I WAS night watch. Now everybody's up all night, so I'm just... Pete.
pete[tired]: I've been asleep since the treasure room. Slept through the whole thing. Then I woke up and it was THIS.
pete.p4_s2: pete[tired]: 'Bad here, probably.' That's not a forecast, Captain. That's just the ship.
pete.p4_washroom_hint: pete[worried]: The washroom's off the crew quarters, Captain. The door by the hammocks. And the scuttle's on deck, forward, by the bell. Garrick's standing on it.
pete.p4_s3_1: pete[worried]: Where's the Center, Captain? ...Right. Then I'm going to go and stand somewhere else.
pete.p4_s3_2: pete[tired]: I carry my pillow everywhere now. In case it's the quarters again. It's not really a pillow any more. It's a sort of cushion of regret.
pete.p4_s3b: pete[sad]: Nobody touch the pillow. Nobody SMELL the pillow.
pete.p4_s4: pete[tired]: I've started sleeping with my boots on. In case. My feet are very unhappy about it.
pete.p4_s5: pete[tired]: Worst job on the ship. I did three shifts yesterday. I've started having dreams about noses.
pete.p4_s6: pete[alarmed]: Is she going to sink, Captain? You can tell me. I won't panic. I'm ALREADY panicking. You can't make it worse.
pete.p4_s7: pete[happy]: That's a GOOD board, Captain. That'll still be there tomorrow.
pete.p4_s8: pete[sad]: It was a good board.
pete.p4_s9: pete[tired]: Seven hundred percent. Yeah. That's the first forecast I've ever believed.
